messages:
alex: Heads-up 1: Zeno wants a short QA-focused thermal sweep to validate perf/W claims before we approve a joint blog. Proposed scope: 6-hour validation on 2 boards, fp16 13b, batches 1/8, ambient vs raised temp.

jordan: OK. Can Zeno provide chamber temps or should we simulate with directed fans? We prefer chamber for clean numbers.

mira: Zeno will use chamber for elevated temp. They asked for a minimal playbook we can run locally too. Keep it light: checklists + one-line run commands.

ops_bot: Lab provisioned: 2x ZS-32 in rack D2, external power meters attached. Prom endpoint: https://prom.zeno/qa/19777. S3: s3://redwood-partners/zeno-qa-19777.

alex: Minimal run matrix: model=rtx-13b(fp16), batch=[1,8], seq=256, temp=[22,30], kernel=stock. Warmup=2k tokens, steady=15min. Tag runs with run_id and git_sha.

jordan: Add `nvidia-smi` and ADC trace sampling at 1s/500Hz respectively. Also capture `uname -a` and bios.

mira: I'll write the playbook and one-liners. Example:

`./run_infer.sh --model rtx-13b --batch 8 --seq 256 --duration 900 --label "zeno-qa-1977701234-b8"`

alex: Dry-run Fri 14:00 PT. If green, approval to proceed for final validation next Wed. jordan/mira please sync on the dashboard panels needed.

jordan: Will add panels: tokens/s, perf_per_w, gpu_temp, ambient_temp, p95 latency. Alert if perf_per_w variance >7% across repeated runs.

mira: Done. Uploading playbook shortly. Closing thread until dry-run. :white_check_mark:
